nodes.label: NotificationController
nodes.description: Manages user notifications: listing, marking read/dismissed, pagination via ip_notifications table

nodes.label: NotificationController::index()
nodes.description: Fetches user's notifications with pagination, scoped to user_id

nodes.label: NotificationController::markAllRead()
nodes.description: Marks all unread notifications as read for current user

nodes.label: NotificationController::markRead()
nodes.description: Marks single notification as read by id and user_id

nodes.label: NotificationController::dismiss()
nodes.description: Deletes/dismisses a notification record

nodes.label: OffboardingController
nodes.description: Manages employee exit/offboarding with role-based RBAC and 8-item checklist

nodes.label: OffboardingController::index()
nodes.description: Lists active offboarding cases (not Completed) and completed cases separately

nodes.label: OffboardingController::store()
nodes.description: Creates new offboarding case with employee link, department, exit type, and assigned HR

nodes.label: OffboardingController::updateChecklist()
nodes.description: Updates 8-item checklist, auto-completes offboarding and suspends user when all items done, logs audit

nodes.label: PayrollController
nodes.description: Manages payroll runs and payslips with role-based access (manage/view/pay), integrates PayrollService

nodes.label: PayrollController::index()
nodes.description: Lists payroll runs with YTD paid total, can_manage/can_pay flags based on role

nodes.label: PayrollController::show()
nodes.description: Retrieves single payroll run with eager-loaded payslips sorted by employee name

nodes.label: PayrollController::store()
nodes.description: Creates payroll run for given month, dispatches GeneratePayrollJob asynchronously, logs audit

nodes.label: PayrollController::destroy()
nodes.description: Deletes draft payroll run only, logs audit event

nodes.label: PayrollController::finalize()
nodes.description: Finalizes draft run with row-lock, recalculates totals, sets status to Finalized

nodes.label: PayrollController::markPaid()
nodes.description: Marks finalized run as Paid with row-lock, logs audit with net_total

nodes.label: PayrollController::updatePayslip()
nodes.description: Updates LOP/TDS on draft payslip, recomputes via PayrollService, refreshes run totals

nodes.label: PayrollController::mySlips()
nodes.description: Employee self-service: lists own finalized/paid payslips only (hides drafts)

nodes.label: PayrollController::refreshTotals()
nodes.description: Private helper: aggregates payslip totals (count, gross, deductions, net) and updates run

nodes.label: PerformanceController
nodes.description: Manages performance reviews, goals, and 360° feedback with RBAC

nodes.label: PerformanceController::index()
nodes.description: Lists all reviews, goals, and feedback360 records in single response

nodes.label: PerformanceController::submitReview()
nodes.description: Submits performance review with 5-point scores, calculates average rating, sets status Completed

nodes.label: PortalController
nodes.description: Manages client portal access toggle, invitations, and credentials creation for external portal

nodes.label: PortalController::clients()
nodes.description: Lists all clients with portal_enabled and portal_invited_at flags

nodes.label: PortalController::toggle()
nodes.description: Toggles portal_enabled for client, sets portal_invited_at if enabling

nodes.label: PortalController::inviteAll()
nodes.description: Batch: sets portal_invited_at on all disabled clients, creates notification record

nodes.label: PortalController::create()
nodes.description: Enables portal for specific client, records email, creates portal_invite notification

nodes.label: ProjectController
nodes.description: Full CRUD for IP projects/matters with pipeline stages, docket numbering, RBAC, caching

nodes.label: ProjectController::inertiaIndex()
nodes.description: Renders Projects Inertia component for SSR

nodes.label: ProjectController::inertiaShow()
nodes.description: Renders ProjectShow Inertia component with projectId prop

nodes.label: ProjectController::stats()
nodes.description: Cached 5min: counts total, open, in_progress, on_hold, overdue projects; scoped by user role

nodes.label: ProjectController::index()
nodes.description: Lists projects with search (name/code/title), status filter, overdue flag, multi-column sort

nodes.label: ProjectController::show()
nodes.description: Returns single project with eager-loaded client, partner, manager, stages, tasks, RBAC validated

nodes.label: ProjectController::store()
nodes.description: Creates project with auto-generated project_code and docket_number, seeds 7 default pipeline stages, logs audit

nodes.label: ProjectController::update()
nodes.description: Updates project fields, logs audit event with changed data

nodes.label: ProjectController::updateStage()
nodes.description: Advances project to stage: marks prior complete, current in-progress, future pending; notifies manager

nodes.label: ProjectController::destroy()
nodes.description: Deletes project only if not Active/In Progress/Open, policy-gated

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController
nodes.description: Tracker CRUD: circles, rows, workload analytics, calendar events; client role blocked via middleware

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::middleware()
nodes.description: Middleware: denies all 'client' role access to tracker actions (403)

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::inertiaIndex()
nodes.description: Renders ProjectTracker Inertia component

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::circles()
nodes.description: Lists all tracker circles with member details

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::rows()
nodes.description: Lists tracker rows for circle slug, eager-loads PCM/SCM/PR users, sorts by sort_order and created_at

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::projects()
nodes.description: Lightweight project combobox search by docket_number, project_code, or client name

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::createRow()
nodes.description: Creates empty tracker row in circle with auto-incremented sort_order

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::updateRow()
nodes.description: Updates tracker row fields, auto-computes % completion from status, syncs pipeline stage

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::deleteRow()
nodes.description: Deletes tracker row by id

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::trackerAnalytics()
nodes.description: SQL aggregation: total cases, overdue, payment status distribution, record types, workload per user

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::calendarEvents()
nodes.description: Lists tracker rows with delivery_due_date, filters by user role (PCM/SCM/PR) if not admin

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::addMember()
nodes.description: Adds user to circle members (many-to-many sync without detaching)

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::removeMember()
nodes.description: Removes user from circle members

nodes.label: ProjectTrackerController::syncProjectStage()
nodes.description: Private: auto-seeds 7 stages if missing, advances project to target stage, marks prior complete/future pending

nodes.label: RecruitmentController
nodes.description: Job posting and candidate pipeline management with 5-stage Kanban (Applied→Hired)

nodes.label: RecruitmentController::index()
nodes.description: Lists job postings and candidates grouped by stage with Tailwind color classes

nodes.label: RecruitmentController::storeJob()
nodes.description: Creates job posting with title, department, description, employment type, sets status Active

nodes.label: RecruitmentController::updateJob()
nodes.description: Updates job posting status (Active/Closed)

nodes.label: ReminderController
nodes.description: Manages reminders for deadlines/meetings/follow-ups/renewals, scoped to user or team

nodes.label: ReminderController::index()
nodes.description: Lists reminders scoped to user_id or team scope, grouped into sections (today/week/upcoming)

nodes.label: ReminderController::store()
nodes.description: Creates reminder with title, category, due_date, time, scope (self/team)

nodes.label: ReminderController::update()
nodes.description: Updates reminder completed flag, validates user access (owner or team scope)

nodes.label: ReportsController
nodes.description: 10-report type dispatch with RBAC matrix: portfolio, matters, financials, HRMS, deadlines, etc.

nodes.label: ReportsController::getData()
nodes.description: Main dispatcher: validates type against RBAC matrix, routes to SQL aggregations, returns paginated/collection response

nodes.label: ReportsController::paginatedResponse()
nodes.description: Private: formats paginated report response with type, rows, total, page info, generated_at

nodes.label: ReportsController::collectionPaginatedResponse()
nodes.description: Private: paginates in-memory collection (e.g., aggregated workload) using forPage()

nodes.label: SettingsController
nodes.description: User settings: profile, password, notifications, system config (partner/admin only)

nodes.label: SettingsController::getSettings()
nodes.description: Reads user profile, notification prefs, and system settings (if partner/admin)

nodes.label: SettingsController::updateProfile()
nodes.description: Updates name, email, timezone, language; logs audit event

nodes.label: SettingsController::updatePassword()
nodes.description: Verifies current password, updates to new (hashed), logs audit

nodes.label: SettingsController::updateNotifications()
nodes.description: Updates notification_prefs JSON (taskAssigned, deadlineEmail, pushNotif, etc.)

nodes.label: SettingsController::updateSystem()
nodes.description: Partner/admin: updateOrInsert system_settings (company_name, currency, fiscal_month, max_upload_mb)

nodes.label: SettingsController::resetUserPassword()
nodes.description: Super admin only: resets target user password, logs audit with subject_type/subject_id

nodes.label: TaskController
nodes.description: Task CRUD with policy authorization, time entry logging, actual hours tracking

nodes.label: TaskController::inertiaIndex()
nodes.description: Renders Tasks Inertia component

nodes.label: TaskController::index()
nodes.description: Lists tasks with RBAC: clients see own project tasks, associates see assigned tasks, sorted by due_date

nodes.label: TaskController::store()
nodes.description: Creates task with default assignee/reviewer, status Pending, logs audit

nodes.label: TaskController::update()
nodes.description: Updates task, policy-gated, logs audit event

nodes.label: TaskController::addTimeEntry()
nodes.description: Creates time entry for project/task, increments task.actual_hours, logs audit

nodes.label: TaskController::destroy()
nodes.description: Deletes task, policy-gated

nodes.label: HandleInertiaRequests
nodes.description: Inertia middleware: shares auth user, flash messages to frontend

nodes.label: HandleInertiaRequests::version()
nodes.description: Returns Inertia version for asset versioning

nodes.label: HandleInertiaRequests::share()
nodes.description: Shares auth user object, flash success/error to all Inertia responses

nodes.label: PaginationHelper
nodes.description: Static pagination utility: paginate(query, request) and paginateByOffset()

nodes.label: PaginationHelper::paginate()
nodes.description: Page-based pagination from query builder, returns {data, total, per_page, current_page, last_page, has_more}

nodes.label: PaginationHelper::paginateByOffset()
nodes.description: Offset/limit-based pagination, returns {data, total, limit, offset, has_more}

nodes.description: Client creation validation: type, nationality, GST/PAN/CIN, contacts, jurisdiction, industry, banking

nodes.label: StoreEmployeeRequest
nodes.description: Employee creation validation: name, email, phone, dept, designation, joining date, employment type, salary

nodes.label: StoreProjectRequest
nodes.description: Project creation validation: client_id, name, type, invention title, patent office, deadline, assignments

nodes.label: StoreTaskRequest
nodes.description: Task creation validation: project_id, title, assignee, priority, due_date, billable flag

nodes.label: UpdateClientRequest
nodes.description: Client update validation (sometimes rules): type, name, GST/tax, jurisdictions, banking, status

nodes.label: UpdateEmployeeRequest
nodes.description: Employee update validation: name, phone, dept, designation, employment type/status, salary, reporting manager

nodes.label: UpdateProjectRequest
nodes.description: Project update validation with manager-level RBAC: field updates, stage/deadline changes

nodes.label: UpdateTaskRequest
nodes.description: Task update validation with assignee-level RBAC: title, status, priority, hours, due_date

nodes.description: Queued job: generates payslips for all Active employees, computes deductions, updates run totals

nodes.label: GeneratePayrollJob::handle()
nodes.description: Fetches eligible employees, loops through each, calls PayrollService::computeSlip(), creates Payslip records

nodes.label: GeneratePayrollJob::failed()
nodes.description: Failure handler: logs error, sets run status to Failed

nodes.label: Approval
nodes.description: Approval request: requester→approver, morphable subject, status tracking

nodes.label: Asset
nodes.description: Fixed asset: tag, category, brand, model, serial, status, assigned employee, allocation dates
